starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.player: Which one of these am I actually meant to be saving?

starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.text: Hmmm... neither of them were at the previous council meeting.

starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.text: The goblins get through leaders so fast I find it hard to keep track. I heard the last leader died during a game of pin the tail on the basilisk.

starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.text: Well, no worries. I'm sure if you just find something that they'll both eat then that should work. I hope.

starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.player: Remembering the last time I dealt with these two, that may be easier said than done.

starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-the-goblin-gener.text: Well you could try asking some of the other goblins in their village for ideas. You should be able to find it just to the North of Falador, unless they've decided the sky is the wrong colour there or something.

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: So... I don't suppose you can remember how I defeated him can you?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?

options.text: Protecting the Dwarf
Protecting the Goblins

steps.player: Those bickering goblins... How did I protect them again?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Well, that was a weird one alright, you told me that they couldn't agree on what food they liked, so you ended up just mushing a bunch of stuff together somehow which seemed to do the trick.

steps.player: Oh yeah... I remember now...

steps.speaker: Cook

steps.text: No you weren't! That was me!

steps.player: Never mind that, don't you remember the spell?

steps.text: All me remember is Wartface stealin' chair!

steps.text: I there before you were. So I get chair...

options.text: Market research.

steps.text: But us never use your markets.

steps.player: Exactly. That's why we need to find out what goblins eat, so we can better cater to your needs.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Go away human, we busy.

steps.player: But it'll only take a minute of your time.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: I said we busy!

options.text: Erm... no particular reason.

options.text: So how is life for the goblins?

asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.player: Hey, I need your help. Wartface and Bentnoze have been cursed!

asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.speaker: Goblin
asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.text: What that got to do with me?

asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.player: I need to find a meal they'd both eat.

asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.speaker: Goblin
asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.text: Me no chef, ask village cook instead.

asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.speaker: Goblin Cook
asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.text: Go away human, me's busy here!

asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.speaker: Goblin Cook
asking-around-goblin-village-talking-to-.text: Me's working on new way of cooking. Will be most famous-est goblin cook ever.

options.text: What is this new way of cooking?

steps.player: What is this new way of cooking?

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Got the idea from the dwarves. Saw them playing with something. They called it a malty canned nun or summat. Used lotsa heat and bright light.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Wouldn't tell Mudknuckles how it worked of course. But I figured it out. Mudknuckles is smarter than them. Now I'm gonna be able to cook better'n anyone. And faster too, yes.

options.text: I need your help...
Well, good luck with that.

steps.player: Well, good luck with that.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: No luck. Will work cos Mudknuckles destined for great things.

options.text: I need your help...

steps.player: I need your help. Wartface and Bentnoze have been trapped by a terrible curse!

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Oh, maybe that why Mudknuckles not been shouted at recently.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Hmmm, s'pose me should help. But first Mudknuckles must finish experiment. Unfortunately is missing one vital ingredient.

options.text: What do you need? Maybe I can get it for you.

steps.player: What do you need? Maybe I can get it for you.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Is called charcoal. Mudknuckles hear you can get it from shops on Karamja, but the customs officers, they no like goblins any more.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Burnt trees, they good too. Smash 'em up with axes. But Mudknuckles only knows of burnt trees in the wilderness, and Mudknuckles too afraid to go there.

steps.player: Ok, I'll see what I can do.

options.text: I guess I'll come back later then.

options.text: I've got the charcoal you were after.

steps.player: I've got the charcoal you were after.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Really? Then no time to lose. Mudknuckles already have everything else. Sulphur 'n stuff.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Must be moving. Follow me.

steps.text: Absolutely, best idea Mudknuckles ever had.

steps.player: Mudknuckles?

discovering-the-recipe-talking-to-the-bu.text: You the human who helped me. Mudknuckles is very grateful, will be famous real soon now. Is just collecting results. And so many results! On walls, on ceiling, everywhere!

discovering-the-recipe-talking-to-the-bu.speaker: Goblin Cook
discovering-the-recipe-talking-to-the-bu.text: I thinking of calling it fast food, 'cos of how fast it goes from raw to burnt, see?

options.text: That sounds like a great idea.

steps.text: You think so? Everyone else think Mudknuckles crazy. Seem think explosive cooking might be dangerous or summat.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Can't see why. Not like you gonna get food poisoning. Food is very well cooked.

options.text: Do you think that will sell?

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: So maybe some imperfections, but fast food will sell. People buy anything when in hurry, even if does taste like sawdust.

steps.player: That doesn't sound too bad.

steps.player: Anything else?

steps.text: Wartface, he want some nice juicy maggots.

steps.text: Humans use them all the time for fishing. Mudknuckles think this a crazy waste of maggots mind, but each to their own.

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Bentnoze not like maggots, say they're too bland. Would only eat them if they spicier.

steps.player: Ok, is there anything other than orange slices and maggots?

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Bentnoze asked for some bread in the mix.

steps.player: Let me guess, Wartface complained right?

steps.speaker: Goblin Cook
steps.text: Yep, Wartface think bread too crunchy. He prefer slimier soggier food, like the maggots.

steps.player: So let me get this straight. I need orange slices which aren't orange, maggots that aren't bland, and bread which isn't crunchy?

steps.text: Yep, 'bout sums it up. Bring 'em all to me and Mudknuckles will make suitable dish.
